'Granola agent' link on the Syncing and Connected card; plan: IntegrationAgentSection.

findings.description: Citation chips are 21 to 24 px tall in agent answers, below the 32 px target.
findings.expected: Chip with at least 32 px hit area.
findings.actual: 136x21 px (a.cite) in screen 3 and 136x24 px (button.cite) in screen 5.
findings.suggested_fix: Add vertical padding or a transparent hit area to .cite.

findings.description: 'Get a key in Granola ↗' wraps its arrow onto a second line at 390 px (and the geometry audit flags it at 1280 px).
findings.expected: Link on one line (nowrap) at every width.
findings.actual: Arrow is orphaned in m390-int-detail.png and in the Disconnect After frame at 390 px.
findings.suggested_fix: white-space:nowrap on the link or let the label drop its arrow.

findings.description: While the first sync is still 'Syncing' the agent may not find a meeting from 80 days ago. The plan's list of literal 'nothing found' reasons has no 'still syncing' reason, so Maya may conclude Granola data is missing.
findings.expected: The tool reason says the first sync is still running.
findings.actual: granola.md Tool output lists: no synced meetings, older than the 90-day store, AI-data sharing off, teammate's agent. No 'sync still running'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'first sync still running' to the literal reasons in granola.md (Reading). No UI.
